An announced piece stays here with "url": null and is not shown until it is published: add its url, title and date, then rebuild. "checked" is the day the link was opened and the title read; null means the title was not checked against the page. "label" replaces the outlet's name in the line. "logo" names a file in docs/ (press_<outlet>.svg) shown in place of the name; it is drawn in one colour unless "logo_colours" is true. Use a logo only with a source and the right to show it recorded in "logo_source".
